_lisezmoi: Règles nationales, railcards, Rail Ombudsman, tarifs et propriété publique. Fusionné avec data/operators.json par scripts/build-params.py pour produire src/data/params-2026.json. Chaque valeur relue sur la source citée le 2026-10-26.

fares.freezeScope: regulated fares in England: season tickets, peak returns for commuters and off-peak returns between major cities

cards.name: 16-25 Railcard
cards.minFareWhen: before 10am Monday to Friday, except Advance tickets, public holidays and July and August
cards.ages: 16 to 25, and mature students aged 26 and over
cards.notes: 1-year card can be bought until the day before the 26th birthday, 3-year card until the day before the 24th.

cards.name: 26-30 Railcard
cards.minFareWhen: before 10am Monday to Friday, except Advance tickets and public holidays
cards.notes: Digital only; can be bought until the day before the 31st birthday.

cards.name: Senior Railcard
cards.notes: Cannot be used for weekday morning peak trips inside the London and South East area, public holidays aside.

cards.name: Two Together Railcard
cards.ages: two named people aged 16 and over
cards.notes: Not valid before 9:30am Monday to Friday, except public holidays.

cards.name: Network Railcard
cards.travellers: the holder and up to 3 more adults, plus up to 4 children
cards.notes: Valid in the London and South East area only, from 10am on weekdays and at any hour at weekends and on public holidays; £1 minimum child fare.

cards.name: Family & Friends Railcard
cards.travellers: up to 4 adults and 4 children aged 5 to 15, at least 1 named adult and 1 child travelling
cards.notes: Weekday morning peak trips inside the London and South East area are excluded; £1 minimum child fare.

cards.name: Disabled Persons Railcard
cards.ages: people with a qualifying disability, from age 5

cards.name: 16-17 Saver
cards.notes: 50% off Anytime, Off-Peak, Advance and season tickets, no minimum fare; bought from 17 August 2026 it lasts a full year even past the 18th birthday.

cards.name: Veterans Railcard
cards.minFareWhen: before 10am Monday to Friday, except Advance tickets, public holidays and July and August
cards.ages: veterans of the UK armed forces
cards.travellers: the holder, 1 named adult companion and up to 4 children
